title: Property & Real Estate Operations Core v1

domain.name: Property & Real Estate Operations
domain.description: Practical property inspections, maintenance planning, turnovers, vendor coordination, budgeting, records, occupant communication, and risk-aware facilities operations.

competencies.name: Property Inspection & Condition Documentation
competencies.description: Observe and document property condition, defects, photos, priorities, and follow-up needs.
competencies.purpose: Create evidence for maintenance and turnover decisions.

units.title: Inspection workflow
units.content: Use a repeatable room or area checklist; photograph context and detail; record location and severity; distinguish observation from diagnosis; identify urgent safety concerns; assign follow-up.

units.title: Describe what you see
units.content: Write observable conditions such as staining, movement, odor, damage, or non-operation instead of declaring hidden causes without evidence.

units.title: Inspection failures
units.content: Avoid unsafe access, opening energized or hazardous systems, diagnosing structural failure from appearance alone, and losing before-and-after documentation.

drills.title: Create a condition report
drills.prompt: Turn a set of hypothetical observations into a property condition report.

competencies.name: Preventive Maintenance Planning
competencies.description: Schedule recurring inspections and service for building systems and assets.
competencies.purpose: Reduce avoidable failures and emergency work.

units.title: PM program
units.content: Inventory maintainable assets; record manufacturer or qualified guidance; define inspection or service tasks; assign frequency and owner; track completion and exceptions; update from failures.

units.title: Frequency should follow evidence
units.content: Use manufacturer guidance, usage, environment, and failure history rather than arbitrary calendar habits.

units.title: PM failures
units.content: Avoid servicing safety-critical equipment beyond competence, missing access requirements, and closing work orders without evidence of completion.

drills.title: Build a preventive maintenance plan
drills.prompt: Create a basic PM schedule for a small mixed-use property.

competencies.name: Work Orders & Maintenance Triage
competencies.description: Capture requests, classify urgency, assign work, track parts, communicate status, and close with evidence.

units.title: Work-order lifecycle
units.content: Record location and symptom; assess safety and service impact; prioritize; assign qualified worker or vendor; document materials and actions; verify fix; close with notes or photos.

units.title: Urgency is impact plus risk
units.content: A nuisance and a life-safety issue should not share the same queue priority even if both were reported first.

units.title: Work-order failures
units.content: Avoid vague tickets, duplicate dispatch, closing on attempted contact only, and sending unqualified labor to regulated or hazardous work.

drills.title: Triage maintenance requests
drills.prompt: Prioritize a list of property issues and assign next actions.

competencies.name: Turnover & Make-Ready Operations
competencies.description: Plan cleaning, repairs, paint, fixtures, inspections, keys, photos, and readiness checks between occupants or uses.
competencies.purpose: Return units or spaces to documented ready condition efficiently.

units.title: Turnover sequence
units.content: Document move-out condition; separate policy or legal questions from repair needs; scope work; sequence dirty-to-clean and wet-to-dry tasks; complete qualified repairs; final clean; safety and readiness inspection; new photos.

units.title: Sequence prevents rework
units.content: Complete invasive or dusty work before final cleaning and finish touch-ups.

units.title: Turnover failures
units.content: Avoid painting over moisture, hiding defects, rekeying without access-control records, and making legal deposit or damage determinations without current policy and law.

drills.title: Build a unit turnover plan
drills.prompt: Sequence a hypothetical apartment turnover with repairs and cleaning.

competencies.name: Property Vendor & Contractor Coordination
competencies.description: Scope, schedule, supervise, document, and close outsourced property work.
competencies.purpose: Get reliable maintenance work without losing control of access or quality.

units.title: Contractor workflow
units.content: Define scope and access; verify required qualifications; confirm schedule and contact; protect occupant and privacy boundaries; document change orders; inspect completion; retain invoices and warranties.

units.title: Access is part of scope
units.content: Keys, codes, occupied-space entry, and after-hours access must be controlled as deliberately as the repair itself.

units.title: Contractor failures
units.content: Avoid giving permanent shared codes, accepting undocumented scope changes, skipping qualification for regulated work, and paying before completion is verified.

drills.title: Close a property repair
drills.prompt: Build a closeout checklist for a contractor repair in an occupied property.

competencies.name: Utilities, Building Systems & Escalation Boundaries
competencies.description: Recognize basic HVAC, plumbing, electrical, water, gas, fire-safety, and utility system states and when to escalate.
competencies.purpose: Support safe triage without unsafe repair attempts.

units.title: Observation does not grant repair authority
units.content: You can identify symptoms, shutoffs, alarms, leaks, or service loss within training, but regulated or hazardous repair requires qualified personnel.

units.title: System incident triage
units.content: Protect people; identify affected area; observe alarms, smells, leaks, or service loss; use only known safe shutoffs within policy; contact qualified service or emergency authority as needed; document.

units.title: System safety failures
units.content: Do not work energized, enter confined or contaminated areas, disturb suspected gas systems, bypass fire protection, or make structural changes without qualified authority.

drills.title: Triage a building-system incident
drills.prompt: Choose safe actions for several property system failures.

competencies.name: Property Operating Budget & CapEx Planning
competencies.description: Track recurring costs, reserves, major repairs, vendor spend, and capital priorities.
competencies.purpose: Make maintenance spending predictable and evidence-based.

units.title: Budget workflow
units.content: Separate operating expense from planned capital needs; use asset condition and service history; estimate timing and range; track actuals; update forecast after major failures or projects.

units.title: Deferred maintenance is not free
units.content: Postponing work can shift cost into emergency repair, damage, downtime, or safety exposure.

units.title: Budget failures
units.content: Avoid treating rough estimates as bids, ignoring lifecycle replacement, and optimizing monthly spend while creating larger future risk.

drills.title: Build a property capital plan
drills.prompt: Prioritize several major property needs over a multi-year horizon.

competencies.name: Property Records, Occupant Communication & Privacy
competencies.description: Maintain service records, inspections, access logs, notices, and communications with appropriate privacy.
competencies.purpose: Create a trustworthy operational history of the property.

units.title: Recordkeeping workflow
units.content: Keep dated work orders, inspection evidence, vendor records, access events, warranties, and approved notices; limit sensitive data; use verified contact channels; preserve retention rules.

units.title: Records should answer who, what, when, and where
units.content: A useful record lets the next operator understand the event without relying on memory.

units.title: Record failures
units.content: Avoid storing unnecessary personal information, discussing occupant details with unrelated vendors, and presenting notice or lease requirements without verifying current applicable rules.

drills.title: Create an operational property record
drills.prompt: Document a repair, access event, and occupant update.
